claude.continuity: laptop codeword recalled by the API turn; API-requested command recalled by the next laptop turn
claude.laptop_draft_during_api_send: draft intact in the composer, submitted afterwards as its own turn

claude.approval_intent: not raised: the worker declined to request conclusion (lab Overview forbids it); controls verified with a question instead

busy_send_during_kickoff.note: cold master dial included; ran as its own queue turn after the kickoff

codex.attachment_killed: send accepted (queue is independent of the tunnel); attachment reconnected on its own
codex.question: askQuestion raised through the remote gateway, answered with POST /questions/{id}/answer; worker reported the answer
